command:
set -o pipefail
docker-entrypoint.sh postgres >/tmp/postgres.log 2>&1 &
pid=$$!
trap 'kill "$$pid"; wait "$$pid"' TERM INT
for i in $$(seq 1 60); do pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$$POSTGRES_DB" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
gzip -t /backup/engram.sql.gz
sha256sum /backup/engram.sql.gz
gzip -dc /backup/engram.sql.gz > /tmp/backup.dump
if head -c 5 /tmp/backup.dump | grep -q PGDMP; then
 echo format=custom
 pg_restore -h 127.0.0.1 --no-owner --no-acl --exit-on-error -U "$$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$$POSTGRES_DB" /tmp/backup.dump >/tmp/restore.log 2>&1 && touch /tmp/restore-pass
else
 echo format=sql
 psql -h 127.0.0.1 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U "$$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$$POSTGRES_DB" -f /tmp/backup.dump >/tmp/restore.log 2>&1 && touch /tmp/restore-pass
fi
if test -f /tmp/restore-pass; then
 echo RESTORE_PASS
 psql -h 127.0.0.1 -At -U "$$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT 'restored_tables=' || count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema');"
else
 echo RESTORE_FAILED
 for pattern in "does not exist" "role" "connection" "already exists" "invalid command" "syntax error" "custom-format" "permission denied"; do if grep -q "$$pattern" /tmp/restore.log; then echo "failure_category=$$pattern"; fi; done
 exit 1
fi
wait "$$pid"

engram version
engram cloud serve >/tmp/candidate.log 2>&1 &
pid=$$!
trap 'kill "$$pid"; wait "$$pid"' TERM INT
for i in $$(seq 1 60); do
 if wget -q -O /tmp/health http://127.0.0.1:18080/health; then echo CANDIDATE_RESTORED_DB_HEALTH_PASS; touch /tmp/candidate-pass; break; fi
 sleep 1
done
test -f /tmp/candidate-pass || { echo CANDIDATE_HEALTH_FAILED; exit 1; }
trap 'for f in /tmp/smoke-*.log; do test ! -f "$$f" || tail -n 3 "$$f"; done' EXIT
export ENGRAM_DATA_DIR=/tmp/smoke-writer
export ENGRAM_CLOUD_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:18080
export ENGRAM_CLOUD_AUTOSYNC=false
engram save 'Isolated validation 194' 'controlled-roundtrip-194' --project electus-platform --topic validation/194 >/tmp/smoke-save.log 2>&1
engram cloud enroll electus-platform >/tmp/smoke-enroll.log 2>&1
engram sync --cloud --project electus-platform >/tmp/smoke-sync.log 2>&1
engram sync --cloud --project electus-platform >>/tmp/smoke-sync.log 2>&1
export ENGRAM_DATA_DIR=/tmp/smoke-reader
engram cloud enroll electus-platform >/tmp/smoke-enroll-reader.log 2>&1
engram sync --cloud --import --project electus-platform >/tmp/smoke-read-sync.log 2>&1
engram search controlled-roundtrip-194 --project electus-platform > /tmp/readback 2>&1
grep -q 'Isolated validation 194' /tmp/readback
echo CLOUD_ROUNDTRIP_REPEAT_SYNC_PASS
kill "$$pid"
wait "$$pid" || true

engram cloud serve >/tmp/rollback.log 2>&1 &
pid=$$!
for i in $$(seq 1 60); do
 if wget -q -O /tmp/health http://127.0.0.1:18080/health; then echo ROLLBACK_119_AFTER_120_HEALTH_PASS; kill "$$pid"; wait "$$pid" || true; exit 0; fi
 sleep 1
done
echo ROLLBACK_HEALTH_FAILED
exit 1
